decision.observation: Hornet stands at the left edge of the mossy ledge between vine trunks; black foreground blocks further west. The chamber's flat-capped black mushrooms and banded ceiling lie east.
decision.hypothesis: This west edge is blocked; the misty chamber's big flat mushroom caps (possibly standable, as some caps have been) may give access to the upper banded ledges. Head east to the mushrooms and test a cap mount.
decision.memory: Region 2 misty chamber: flat-capped mushrooms never tested for standability.
